mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heart’s own blood vessels was most worthwhile: it explained why blood inside the chambers does not by itself supply the thick heart muscle.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the two vessel loops was straightforward but somewhat repetitive; the final blood-filled picture gave their relationship more meaning.

surprise.text: The heart needs a separate blood supply for its own muscle, even though blood passes through its chambers.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary. The conducting tissue’s purpose was plausible beforehand and became clearer when the result showed the timed electrical wave.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting the coronary supply and tracing the two loops made me curious about how the circulation will support the other body systems.
